_comment: Real rig USB cameras -> observation.images.<key> (recording/real_cameras.py). Orbbecs by serial + colour interface (any port); the ARC wrist cameras have no serial, so by USB port: keep them in the same ports. ARC 640x480 MJPG exists only at 120 fps: decoded at <= 60 fps. 'controls' = camera settings applied on every open (run_cameras.sh --controls lists them): 60 Hz anti-flicker; head exposure fixed at 8.3 ms (= its auto value in the lab, one 120 Hz light-flicker period). Set with recording/run_camera_setup.sh
